### Quickstart with Peekaboo CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/skills/peekaboo/SKILL.md

Basic commands to get started with Peekaboo, including checking permissions, listing applications, taking a screenshot, clicking an element, and typing text.

```bash
peekaboo permissions
peekaboo list apps --json
peekaboo see --annotate --path /tmp/peekaboo-see.png
peekaboo click --on B1
peekaboo type "Hello" --return
```

--------------------------------

### Install Gateway with a Custom Wrapper Script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/gateway.md

This example demonstrates installing the Gateway service using a custom wrapper script, which allows the service to start through another executable like a secrets manager shim.

```bash
cat > ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec doppler run --project my-project --config production -- openclaw "$@"
EOF
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler

openclaw gateway install --wrapper ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler --force
openclaw gateway restart
```

### Set up and run OpenClaw in development mode

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/README.md

Clone the repository, install dependencies, run the initial setup, and start the development loop with auto-reload.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw

pnpm install

# First run only (or after resetting local OpenClaw config/workspace)
pnpm openclaw setup

# Optional: prebuild Control UI before first startup
pnpm ui:build

# Dev loop (auto-reload on source/config changes)
pnpm gateway:watch
```

--------------------------------

### GET /__openclaw__/assistant-media

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/web/control-ui.md

Retrieves metadata and a short-lived media ticket for assistant local-media previews.

```APIDOC
## GET /__openclaw__/assistant-media

### Description
Retrieves metadata and a short-lived media ticket for assistant local-media previews. The returned ticket is used to authorize subsequent media rendering.

### Method
GET

### Endpoint
/__openclaw__/assistant-media

### Parameters
#### Query Parameters
- **meta** (string) - Required - Must be set to `1` to check availability.
- **source** (string) - Required - The path to the media source.

### Headers
- **Authorization** (string) - Required (when gateway auth is configured) - Bearer token.

### Response
#### Success Response (200)
- **mediaTicket** (string) - A short-lived ticket scoped to the exact source path.
```

--------------------------------

### GET /avatar/<agentId>

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/web/control-ui.md

Retrieves the avatar image or metadata for a specific agent. Requires gateway token authentication when configured.

```APIDOC
## GET /avatar/<agentId>

### Description
Retrieves the avatar image or metadata for a specific agent. Requires gateway token authentication when configured.

### Method
GET

### Endpoint
/avatar/<agentId>

### Parameters
#### Path Parameters
- **agentId** (string) - Required - The ID of the agent.

#### Query Parameters
- **meta** (string) - Optional - Set to `1` to return avatar metadata instead of the image.

### Headers
- **Authorization** (string) - Required (when gateway auth is configured) - Bearer token.
```

### Configure Installer Specs for Skill Dependencies

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/tools/skills.md

Specify installer details (such as Homebrew formulas) within the metadata block to guide the macOS Skills UI on how to install missing dependencies.

```markdown
---
name: gemini
description: Use Gemini CLI for coding assistance and Google search lookups.
metadata:
  {
    "openclaw":
      {
        "emoji": "♊️",
        "requires": { "bins": ["gemini"] },
        "install":
          [
            {
              "id": "brew",
              "kind": "brew",
              "formula": "gemini-cli",
              "bins": ["gemini"],
              "label": "Install Gemini CLI (brew)",
            },
          ],
      },
  }
---
```

### Example Project Environment File

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/scripts/clawdock/README.md

Shows a typical `<project>/.env` file, configuring Docker infrastructure settings like image name, ports, and gateway token.

```bash
OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw
OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw/workspace
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT=18789
OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_PORT=18790
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND=lan
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=<generated-by-docker-setup>
OPENCLAW_AUTH_PROFILE_SECRET_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw-auth-profile-secrets
OPENCLAW_IMAGE=openclaw:local
```

### Example Stdin Payload for Install Policy

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/tools/skills-config.md

The JSON payload structure sent to the stdin of the configured policy command during an installation request.

```json
{
  "protocolVersion": 1,
  "openclawVersion": "2026.6.1",
  "targetType": "skill",
  "targetName": "weather",
  "sourcePath": "/var/folders/.../openclaw-skill-clawhub/root",
  "sourcePathKind": "directory",
  "source": {
    "kind": "clawhub",
    "authority": "openclaw",
    "mutable": false,
    "network": true
  },
  "origin": {
    "type": "clawhub",
    "registry": "https://clawhub.openclaw.ai",
    "slug": "weather",
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "request": {
    "kind": "skill-install",
    "mode": "install",
    "requestedSpecifier": "clawhub:weather@1.0.0"
  },
  "skill": {
    "installId": "clawhub"
  }
}
```

    appRecommendations: true,
    lastRunAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    lastRunVersion: "2026.1.4",
    lastRunCommit: "abc1234",
    lastRunCommand: "configure",
    lastRunMode: "local",
    securityAcknowledgedAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  },
}
```

### createOptionalChannelSetupSurface

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/sdk-setup.md

Creates optional setup surfaces that should only appear in certain contexts, returning a setup adapter and wizard.

```APIDOC
## createOptionalChannelSetupSurface(options)

### Description
Helper function to generate optional setup surfaces that only appear in specific contexts. The generated adapter and wizard fail closed on real config writes and reuse an install-required message.

### Parameters
- **options** (object) - Configuration options.
  - **channel** (string) - Required. The channel identifier.
  - **label** (string) - Required. Display label for the channel.
  - **npmSpec** (string) - Required. NPM package specification.
  - **docsPath** (string) - Optional. Path to the documentation.

### Returns
- **Object** containing:
  - **setupAdapter** (object)
  - **setupWizard** (object)

### Example
```typescript
import { createOptionalChannelSetupSurface } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-setup";

const setupSurface = createOptionalChannelSetupSurface({
  channel: "my-channel",
  label: "My Channel",
  npmSpec: "@myorg/openclaw-my-channel",
  docsPath: "/channels/my-channel",
});
```
```

### Automated OpenClaw Installation via Shelley

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/exe-dev.md

Use this prompt with the Shelley agent to automate the installation, Nginx configuration, and setup of OpenClaw on an exe.dev VM.

```text
Set up OpenClaw (https://docs.openclaw.ai/install) on this VM. Use the non-interactive and accept-risk flags for openclaw onboarding. Add the supplied auth or token as needed. Configure nginx to forward from the default port 18789 to the root location on the default enabled site config, making sure to enable Websocket support. Pairing is done by "openclaw devices list" and "openclaw devices approve <request id>". Make sure the dashboard shows that OpenClaw's health is OK. exe.dev handles forwarding from port 8000 to port 80/443 and HTTPS for us, so the final "reachable" should be <vm-name>.exe.xyz, without port specification.
```

### AI-Evaluated Discretion Condition Example

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/extensions/open-prose/skills/prose/compiler.md

This example demonstrates using discretion markers (`**...**`) for AI-evaluated conditions to guide session execution based on code analysis.

```prose
let analysis = session "Analyze the codebase"

if **the code has security vulnerabilities**:
  session "Fix security issues immediately"
    context: analysis
elif **the code has performance issues**:
  session "Optimize performance bottlenecks"
    context: analysis
else:
  session "Proceed with normal review"
    context: analysis
```

sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
```

### Non-interactive vLLM Onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/vllm.md

```bash
openclaw onboard --non-interactive \
  --mode local \
  --auth-choice vllm \
  --custom-base-url "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1" \
  --custom-api-key "vllm-local" \
  --custom-model-id "your-model-id"
```

### PostgreSQL Setup and Docker Configuration

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/extensions/open-prose/skills/prose/SKILL.md

Instructions and commands for configuring the PostgreSQL connection string or launching a local instance via Docker.

```text
⚠️  PostgreSQL state requires a connection URL.

To configure:
1. Set up a PostgreSQL database (Docker, local, or cloud)
2. Add connection string to .prose/.env:

   echo "OPENPROSE_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/prose" >> .prose/.env

Quick Docker setup:
   docker run -d --name prose-pg -e POSTGRES_DB=prose -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -p 5432:5432 postgres:16
   echo "OPENPROSE_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/prose" >> .prose/.env

See state/postgres.md for detailed setup options.
```

### Configure Channel Catalog Metadata in package.json

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/architecture-internals.md

Define setup, discovery, and installation metadata for OpenClaw channel plugins. This configuration keeps the core catalog data-free and supports both npm and local path installations.

```json
{
  "name": "@openclaw/nextcloud-talk",
  "openclaw": {
    "extensions": ["./index.ts"],
    "channel": {
      "id": "nextcloud-talk",
      "label": "Nextcloud Talk",
      "selectionLabel": "Nextcloud Talk (self-hosted)",
      "docsPath": "/channels/nextcloud-talk",
      "docsLabel": "nextcloud-talk",
